response.overview: A lighthearted, comedic short that turns a stressful, private emergency into a chaotic spectacle. The story captures the frantic psychological state of a man desperately needing to use the restroom late at night. Inside the tight confines of the bathroom, a family of three anthropomorphic toilets comes to life, subverting expectations by using their unique environment and props to faithfully help humans resolve their "urgent" predicament.
response.title: 馬桶共和國
